description: Get the historical shares-outstanding and cash series from SEC XBRL filings, with offering and material-cash-event overlays so an issuance or a raise can be lined up against the share count and cash balance around it. Use for share count growth over time and for the cash trajectory between financings. 🔴 THE HISTORICAL SHARE COUNTS ARE AS FILED — each point is on the split basis in force when it was reported and is NOT rebased to today, so a reverse split shows as a step and points either side of one are not directly comparable. Do not compute a growth rate across a split boundary from these raw points. A gap in the series means no filing supplied that period, not that the share count was unchanged. ALWAYS RETURNS 200: read `available` and `reason`, never the HTTP status. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. NULL, absent or withheld means NOT MEASURED; it never means "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a MEASURED zero and defeats a null check: decide from the availability/withheld/reason field, never from the value itself. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted, never published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_dilution_history
title: Get Shares-Outstanding and Cash History
